beforeAfter.title: From "What's Wrong?" to "What Should I Do?"
beforeAfter.subtitle: Turn confusion into practical, straightforward next steps for your crops.

before.heading: Damaged Leaf & Uncertainty
before.quote: "Something is wrong with my crop. Is it pest, fungus, or nutrient loss?"
before.state: Risk of crop loss or wrong pesticide purchase

after.action1: Remove and safely discard affected lower leaves
after.action2: Improve airflow and avoid overhead watering on leaves
after.action3: Apply recommended organic neem spray or copper fungicide

beforeAfter.disclaimer: AI-assisted guidance for farmer decision support. For severe outbreaks, always consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
